description: One card's activity log as human lines (who, when, what). Planka logs only creation, moves, member changes and task completion — never comments or edits. Page back with beforeId.

beforeId.description: Cursor: return only events older than this event id. Use nextBeforeId from a previous call.

limit.description: How many events to return, newest first. Default 20, max 50.

name: planka_card_history
title: Card history
